inputs.text: [urgent] [breathing heavily] Harry, come with me. Don't look behind you. I'll explain, but you need to come with me now.
[frightened] You've just come across the room and grabbed me. What am I supposed to think? Tell me what you've seen.
[shaken] That would have gone straight through me. You saw that coming, didn't you? That's why you ran.
[urgent] I saw something above you. I didn't know what it was going to do. Harry, you're looking at the floor. Look at me.
[breathing heavily] I'm looking at the hole where I was standing. Give me a second. I don't even know which way we're going.
[nervous] Neither do I, yet. But the couples are moving and we're moving with them. For the moment, that's all I've got.
